answer: Nonce-Bound Answer Challenge. Each identity must submit a fresh answer to a task whose input includes a server-issued random nonce and a hidden per-round key; the verifier checks the nonce was never issued before and that the answer embeds it correctly. A sybil replaying one answer fails because the nonce never repeats. Attacker cost is one distinct computation per identity per round, plus storage for unused nonces; batching clones saves nothing since each needs its own signed nonce. Tokens are tagged with cedar, quartz, sonnet markers to bind rounds.
